# Synthetic metric audit acceptance fixture

This original finite 100-row CPU fixture verifies Index intake, immutable source registration, repair and reproduction. It is excluded from the ten-Contribution release corpus and from organic value, novelty, model quality or generalization claims.

The fixed 90/10 labels yield majority accuracy 0.90, macro accuracy 0.50 and minority accuracy zero. The control copies the label and therefore yields 1.00; that leakage is intentional. All original files are offered under CC0-1.0.
